title: Steer a current plan
current: Steering takes operator-written goals and a high-level strategy plan, proposes parallel dashes with dependency edges, and vets each with a subagent for overengineering. Prefer simplifying or deleting and avoid new DB fields or migrations. Present each vetted dash and every other decision one at a time with context and a recommendation; file only with explicit approval and keep the strategy doc current. Explicit operator choices of Blitz, epic or task remain available. Major scope proposals explain what they add, why and the simplest alternative, including DB changes; reviewers check for these too. Root-cause nontrivial defects with subagents. As work lands, seek decisions for the next set or propose and vet it when clear. After failed item delivery QA, confirm and staff correction ownership, arrange qualifying delivery, preserve the original owner, inspect notice delivery and arrange supported resume/restaff if the surface lacks automatic wake. A dependency notice reports facts; activation GO remains a steering instruction. PRINCIPAL-level launches, including restaff, require explicit operator approval because they consume far more tokens; ordinary staffing is unchanged.
